summary.text:
Global equities tumbled as geopolitical tensions flared with Iran claiming control of the Strait of Hormuz amid intensifying strikes. Tech suffered sharp losses, with Nvidia plunging 14.01% to 125.53, dragging the Nasdaq 100 down 5.61% to 25028.9805 and the S&P 500 down 3.7% to 6910.3901. Market volatility surged, pushing the VIX up 26.2% to 35.89.

In currencies and commodities, the dollar index dipped 0.06% to 103.84, with USDJPY down 0.55% to 158.512. Energy markets were mixed as WTI crude edged up 0.24% to 83.41, while Brent declined 2.21% to 89.95. Gold dropped 4.62% to 3515.3999, and Bitcoin traded at 60226.0586.

Looking ahead, focus turns to COP31 negotiations as parties attempt to break an impasse after EU warnings of a no deal. Investors also monitor Middle East developments surrounding Hormuz, alongside questions regarding whether the AI boom is losing its grip on emerging economies.
